bio: I'm Anas, a visual artist and art director based in Dubai. I direct, design, model in 3D, animate, film and draw, and I like owning a piece of work from the first idea to the final file.

Today I lead creative content at MangoBot, a company building AI and humanoid robots. I built the brand identity and the in-house video production from the ground up, and I direct, film and edit the company's films.

Before that I was a senior graphic designer at Promate Technologies, where I taught myself Blender and made 3D a core part of my work. It all started with a pencil, and I still draw. Right now I'm writing and producing my own short film.
